messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem: auth-service noisy 5xx alerts caused ~90 pages overnight. Root cause: brief downstream timeout storms + rigid thresholds. Need concrete remediation list.

owen: I'll run threshold sensitivity and propose switching to a 99th-percentile with a 90s sustain. Will post sims by Tue noon.

frank: I can own dedupe and suppression. Proposal: key on service:status_code with a 180s suppression window and send aggregated payloads instead of separate pages.

oncall-bot: incident INC-20260405-AUTH triggered 92 times. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/auth-5xx

kevin: Ops wants paging change: only page on sustained 2 hits within 3m or >5x baseline error rate. Canary 24h at 10% pagers. Owen/Frank please add rollback steps.

owen: ack. sustain window = 90s in sims. Rollback for threshold change: revert percentile flag to static 95th via config toggle.

frank: rollback cmd for dedupe:
kubectl apply -f alerting/dedupe/disable-agg.yaml
I'll add runbook snippet.

maya: owners & deadlines recap: sims (owen) Tue noon, dedupe+docs (frank) Wed 10:00, canary (kevin) Thu 03:00 UTC. Follow-up sync Fri 09:00 UTC.

kevin: I'll add dashboards: pages/hour, sustained-alerts, dedupe-hit-rate. Track recurrence for 30 days and escalate if incidents >=2.

maya: thanks all. I'll update the PM tracker with these action items and owners.
